scope: Public runnable 6-max standard no-limit Holdem, handwritten policies; static equity tables and Monte Carlo evaluation allowed. No trained policy weights/CFR blueprint in the handwritten candidate group.
search_queries: github poker bot heuristic 6 max no limit holdem rule based tournament winner
github fullhouse hackathon poker bot heuristic rule based winner

classification.solver_like: Handwritten hand buckets, fixed ranges, deterministic mixed actions; no actual solver despite name.
classification.cfr_lite: Handwritten equity and action EV formulas, positive-regret weighting at one decision; no trained CFR policy or self-play table.
classification.hydra: Handwritten opponent profiling and Monte Carlo equity.
classification.txnujk: Submitted floorfix heuristic; separate CFR variant is not used.
classification.vikram: Submitted v12 candidate with handwritten rules/profiling and Monte Carlo/exact river evaluation.
classification.pantheon: Final v16_squeeze_C_metacap; handwritten rules/ranges and equity simulation. Author reports fifth in Fullhouse final; not independently verified here.
classification.fold_equity: Handwritten preflop ranges and postflop per-action expected value, with range-conditioned Monte Carlo.

excluded_other_sources.reason: Mixed CFR-blueprint architecture, Python-only multiway simulation; no verified 1 ms runtime or independent strength evidence. Not included in timed shortlist.

measurement_notes: Initial pantheon_32/64 pilot changed only global iteration caps, missing function-default range sampling caps. Those pilot records are retained but superseded by latency_pantheon_corrected, which caps both paths; no strength results were used to make this implementation correction.
Screen timing excludes caught-exception candidates. Rare wall-clock outliers can exclude a candidate in a small screen; this search is conservative, not exhaustive.
Frozen source tables may be approximations; a matching API and low latency do not establish globally strong poker.
